name: AUX_SUPPLY
description: Auxiliary power supply - three sub-regulators providing 5V, 3.3V, and 1.2V from 12V main output

ports.name: VIN_12V
ports.description: 12V input from main LLC converter output

ports.name: VOUT_5V
ports.description: 5V output for analog control circuits and gate drivers (500mA max)

ports.name: VOUT_1V2
ports.description: 1.2V output for RP2040 core (100mA max, nominally 1.1V per RP2040 spec)
